reviews.review:
One of the best free to play games I've ever played.

Pay to win game? Hell no. Most of everything in the game can be earned through missions, either it be boss fights, surviving in defense or survival missions for a long time, or going into the void and doing missions.

RANK SYSTEM : You rank up throughout the game, either by doing missions, leveling up your weapons, etc.
When you have a higher rank, it allows you to use epic weapons of mass destruction. I'm not kidding. Some of the weapons in the game just destroy everything in it's path with little effort.

WARFRAMES : There are tons of Warframes to gather throughout the game. At the start you get to pick between 3 warframes. EXCALIBER, VOLT, and LOKI. If you like stealth, go with Loki. If you like slicing enemies into little bits of meat, go with Excaliber. If you like frying your enemies with electricity and super human speed, go with Volt.

Other warframes can be gathered through boss fights, void missions, or alerts.

WEAPONS : Tons and tons of weapons to choose from, giving you a different experience everytime. You can switch up weapons easily and change your style anytime you want in your Arsenal. 

PRIMARY WEAPONS : You have your rifles, shotguns, grenade launchers, flame throwers, rocket launchers, laser guns that shoot laser cubes and explode on impact with a chain of more explosions, guns that shoot bolts that pin enemies to walls, rifles that shoot lasers that cut through groups of enemies, sniper rifles. etc.

SECONDARY WEAPONS : You have your pistols, hand held rocket launchers, infected pistols that shoot poison and radiate enemies, one handed automatic crossbows, duel magnums, duel machine gun pistols, pistols that can also shoot bolts and pin enemies to walls, duel one handed shotguns, etc.

MELEE WEAPONS : You have quite a selection. Two handed swords, warhammers, giant axes, and maces.

One handed swords, either they can be normal swords, or infected swords, eletric plasma swords, fire swords, or heavy hitting maces, axes, hammers, scythes, ninja stars, a blade weapon that can be thrown that cuts down enemies in it's path and comes back to you like a boomerang, then can be used for close range attacks, etc.

SENTINELS : These little guys are droids that follow you around, there are a few of them, but are worth getting for a little extra help. I apologize that I cannot remember the names lol, but the one I use is like a vaccum. It sucks up all the ammo and loot, even energy orbs and health orbs. It also has a shotgun equipped to it, so if enemies come close they get blasted in the face.

Some sentinels are used for just doing tons of damage, but others are used to make go invisible, stomp the ground making enemies fall on their butt, or suck up everything with a vaccum. I recommend getting the vaccum one if you're a new player, since you'll get so much more loot with little effort.

Sentinels can have mods put into them and can be leveled just like your weapons and warframe. Mods like emergency shields incase you're shields run out, a deflecting shield when you are reviving a teammate it will pop a shield over you to give you a little more time to revive before getting attacked. Also it can have weapon mods added into it. Some only use rifle, or shotgun mods. So if you have some extra mods laying around, you can stick them inside your sentinel.

BOSS FIGHTS : Most of the boss fights are epic, each boss does it's own thing and has it's own way of being defeated. Once you defeat a boss, you'll get some materials and a mod. At the end of the mission is when you get a blueprint. Gather blueprints to create whatever the blueprint was, you'll need to defeat the boss a couple of times because it's random when it comes to getting blueprints. Example : Getting the Rhino warframe, defeat the boss and you get a RHINO SYSTEMS blueprint. You'll need to get the RHINO CHASIS and the RHINO HELMET as well, in order to build the Rhino. 

So you'll need to fight the boss more than once if you want all the blueprints for that certain warframe. Sometimes you'll keep getting the same blueprint, but you can sell the extra blueprints for some credits if you're not going to use it.

RANDOM ASSASSINATIONS : Most of the time when you kill a boss you'll get a thing in the mail saying "You'll pay for what you have done, TENNO" 

This means that a assassin will come and try to kill you randomly in a mission. You're screen will start to flicker and that's signals that the assassin is coming for you. If it's flickering but you do no receive a messege saying they are coming for you, that means the assassin is coming for someone else in your group.

These assassins are able to be killed, but won't go down easy if you're a low level. Once they are killed you get a blueprint from them. If it's the STALKER, you get a chance to get either one of his weapons. It can be the DREAD, which is the bow and arrow, HATE which is his melee scythe weapon, and his secondary which I forgot. Most of the time you'll get the Dread bow, I have like 14 of them lol.

There are other assassins which I won't spoil for you lol. But most of the time you'll be hunted by the Stalker, once you start killing high leveled bosses, that's when higher leveled assassins will come for you, and they all do different things and have different styles of fighting.

WHEN an a assassin comes, they only go for their target and no one else unless they get in the way. So play it smart and get some distance so your teammates can pound them into the ground, making it easier to kill them.

DOJO/CLANS : A dojo is where you can design and build your own base. Adding rooms and decorations to each spot and being able to build workshops that create weapons that cannot be purchased in the market with credits. So you'll get access to some really unique weapons. You get to build 3 workshops and they're all different. One is for Grineer weapons, the other is Corpus weapons, and the last is Infected weapons. 

This will allow you to research and build weapons that the enemies are using and can use them for yourself. I recommend new players to join other clans/dojos. Because it costs a lot of materials to build your own dojo. Usually other clans have fully built these workshops and have researched everything. If you decide to build your own, that's cool too, but it'll cost a lot of materials and it takes a lot of effort doing it by yourself.

COMMUNITY : The community is cool most of the time. You'll always have high ranked players helping low ranked players with missions or boss fights. I like to go help ranked 2 players, because I can give them mods and other goodies. When you play for a long time, you'll gather so much materials you won't know what to do with it, so it's best to give them to low ranked players, or go to the trading chat to sell. (You'll need to be rank #2 in order to trade in a dojo, and need credits too, because the dojo might have a trading fee)

TRADING SYSTEM : You can trade with other players in a Dojo, by them inviting you to it, or you inviting them. You can trade all sorts of stuff, Void keys, mods, blueprints, etc. It's impossible to be scammed in the game, and everybody usually doesn't try to anyways. I recommend going to the Warframe Wiki and checking out the prices for rare mods, because sometimes you'll have players lie about the platinum price for the item you're trying to sell or buy. Trades go smooth most of the time, I don't want to make you feel uncomfortable about trading, I'm just saying that you should do some research about it before doing so.

UPDATES/EVENTS : These guys update this game almost twice every month, and everytime it's something big, they usually add missions where you can get some sweet weapons or other goodies. Events are awesome too, because you'll get a chance to get all the blueprints for one warframe, or get a sweet looking helmet for your warframe or a weapons.
Hard to control precisly, horrible blury in yer face graphics even at full HD. must be for console players on big tv screens... not recommended for PC players. uninstalled after 0.7hrs of play.

What can I say about Warframe?  Personally I think it's a great game.  While yes, parts of it are a bit grindy I enjoy the payoffs and the gameplay.  I would wholeheartedly recommend to anyone who like shooters... and ninjas... in space...

This game is a must to have for anyone who like 3rd person shooters! While there are some weapons, and equipment that you need to buy, since it is hard money (not in game), it is much more satisfying to get it yourself. Even playing it sparingly is good, yet I recommend that you play daily, or at least once a week.

So as far as warframe goes I will say this. It is a very fun run and gun with some fun if highly situational parkour mechanics and a lot of gameplay depth with warframe powers. Sadly the fun will slowly diminish as you see that the maps are repetative and it is a pain in the @55 to get new items. All in all this is a fun run and gun with a lot of gameplay depth. However it takes a lot of time or microtransactions to feel like you are getting anywhere or get new items. (or colors for custumization) But if a night of space ninja fun with three friends. That being said this is a fun game and is free.
